question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%m', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS yr
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    yr,
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_count
  FROM delivered_orders
  WHERE yr IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY month_num, yr
),
monthly_pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2016 THEN delivered_count END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS "2016",
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2017 THEN delivered_count END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS "2017",
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2018 THEN delivered_count END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS "2018"
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY month_num
),
month_names AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month_num, 'January' AS month_name UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, 'February' UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'March' UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'April' UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, 'May' UNION ALL
  SELECT 6, 'June' UNION ALL
  SELECT 7, 'July' UNION ALL
  SELECT 8, 'August' UNION ALL
  SELECT 9, 'September' UNION ALL
  SELECT 10, 'October' UNION ALL
  SELECT 11, 'November' UNION ALL
  SELECT 12, 'December'
)
SELECT 
  mn.month_num,
  mn.month_name,
  COALESCE(mp."2016", 0) AS "2016",
  COALESCE(mp."2017", 0) AS "2017",
  COALESCE(mp."2018", 0) AS "2018"
FROM month_names mn
LEFT JOIN monthly_pivot mp ON mn.month_num = mp.month_num
ORDER BY mn.month_num
